subject: STABLE air-compute-opus #4 + HEAVY RELEASE: special CA classes routed to the generic AIR path (switch TEGU_SPECIAL_CLASSES_GENERIC_DEFAULT=1), TgLength fixes built and replayed; gates green
body: Shared tree: render_pipeline.inc 8596bcc2 (contains my TEGU_SPECIAL_CLASSES_GENERIC_DEFAULT block after the JM routing block + air-render-plan AIR-plan + c6t-rca #8), mali_compute_air.inc d93d030b; host Mali mesa-build 9c4dd137 (rebuilt with the TgLength fix); iOS libNord2Mali.a 124bd24e (contains d93d030b). Gates with routing on: CA host test PASS 47; render harness rc=0; integration --candidate: only the known CoreAnimation pass 66/42 (candidate provenance, native compute, variant threads, legacy sampler, producer all OK). Per-class generic draw requests (227 captured CA records of the classes, AIR generic vs m2v generic, same targets/blend/options): bindings/kinds/stages and framebuffer-read/tile-fetch mode identical 227/227; 108 fully identical; remaining differences only AIR's narrower vertex-attribute mask (subset; encoder fetch follows the compiled mask) and no PSIZ output (m2v-only WRITES_POINT_SIZE). Device/JM note: the JM frontend already routed every pipeline away from these classes before this change (preprocessed JM render_pipeline.inc identical with/without my block), so the device build behaviour does not change and =0 has effect only in the non-JM (CSF) configuration, which currently does not compile for unrelated reasons. TgLength: 136/137 of the previously refused kernels compile with the shared host lib (1 empty kernel under synthetic constants). Next device build may proceed from the current tree.
